subject: design/e2e-verification-artifacts-v2
statement: one e2e design doc per feature is a markdown file instantiated from an `e2e-design/v2` template with a **closed section set** — every section present, an empty one reading a stated `none — <reason>` (`prd:e2e-verification/FR-18`). The header carries the routing pair (`In one line` · `Relevant-when`), a **`Basis`** row typing the feature join (`prd:<feature>` — the coverage source), the **governing-design revision(s)** the coverage was derived from (the live design *set*), and `Status` (`draft` → `approved`).
